title: Blockwise Moment-Map Vector for the General Data Lift
body_html:
Blockwise Moment-Map Vector for the General Data Lift

Let \[ \Sigma=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l \] be the block decomposition of a supercuspidal datum, and let \[ \Sigma'=\#_{V,T'}(\Sigma)=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l' \] be the data-level theta lift. For each positive-depth block \(l>0\), choose \(w_l\in V_l\otimes_DV_l'\) such that \[ \Gamma_l=M(w_l),\qquad \Gamma_l'=M'(w_l). \] Then the block-diagonal vector \[ w=\bigoplus_{0<l\le b}w_l\in V\otimes_DV' \] satisfies \[ \Gamma-M(w)\in\mathbf g_{x,0}, \qquad \Gamma'-M'(w)\in\mathbf g'_{x',0}. \]
proof_html: The positive-depth blocks have mutually distinct depths and are orthogonal in the block decomposition. On the block \(V_l\otimes_DV_l'\), the chosen vector \(w_l\) realizes the two single-block moment-map identities by construction. Off the positive-depth diagonal blocks, the vector \(w\) has no component. Therefore the positive-depth part of \(M(w)\) is exactly \(\bigoplus_{l>0}\Gamma_l\), and the omitted zero-depth block contributes only modulo \(\mathbf g_{x,0}\). The same argument on the target side gives the congruence modulo \(\mathbf g'_{x',0}\).
